_header: Each entry defines a named release as a half-open range (old, new]
of MAM-parsed states, each named by a commit's short hash: a MAM-parsed commit
for the pre-migration boundaries, a MAM-basics commit since.
'old' is the state before the first change (exclusive boundary);
'new' is the state after the last change (inclusive boundary).
Consecutive releases share a boundary: the 'new' of one release
Every boundary is stored in MAM-parsed/historical/, and the change log refuses
one that is not. py/main_diff.py mpplus --pin <name> appends a release ending
at HEAD and stores HEAD; --archive <boundary> stores a boundary added by hand.
py/main_diff.py mpplus also uses these to map --old/--new args to a release
